scenarios.scenario: Show the main regions of an active part workspace

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the 3D Model ribbon is expanded at the top
the application controls occupy the top row
the ribbon tabs appear below the application controls
the active ribbon tab displays grouped commands below the tab row
the model browser and viewport occupy the workspace below the ribbon
the model browser shows the part hierarchy at the left
the viewport displays the part to the right of the browser
the document tab strip shows Home and the active part below the workspace
the status area is visible along the bottom

scenarios.scenario: Keep document tabs below the modeling workspace

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon and model browser are visible
the user inspects the workspace layout
the document tab strip appears below the model browser and viewport
the status area appears below the document tab strip
no document tab strip separates the ribbon from the viewport
the active document remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Keep the default model browser dock compact

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left with its default width
the user inspects the workspace proportions
the model browser occupies about one quarter of the available workspace width
the viewport occupies the remaining width beside the browser
the active part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Give quick access and ribbon tabs separate rows

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the quick access toolbar is configured to appear above the ribbon
the ribbon is docked at the top in its expanded Normal appearance
the user selects the View ribbon tab
quick access remains in the top application bar alongside document context
File appears at the leading edge of the ribbon tab row beneath that bar
the ribbon tabs share that row with File
the selected View tab is visually distinct from the other tabs
the View command panels occupy a separate row beneath the tabs
each visible panel title sits below its commands

scenarios.scenario: Show the Tools tab once in the ribbon navigation row

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is docked at the top in its expanded Normal appearance
the user inspects the ribbon navigation row
File and the command tabs share one row beneath the application bar
the Tools ribbon tab appears once in that row
no separate Tools menu appears before the ribbon tabs
the active part remains displayed

scenarios.scenario: Switch the ribbon to the View tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon tab is active
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the ribbon displays Visibility, Appearance and Windows panels
the viewport navigation controls remain at the right edge
the active document remains displayed

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the View tab user interface options

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab is active
the user opens the User Interface menu
the menu lists the viewport orientation control, navigation bar, contextual command toolbar, status bar, document tabs, marking menu, model browser, rule log, rule automation and favorites
the viewport orientation control, navigation bar, status bar, document tabs, marking menu and model browser are checked
the contextual command toolbar, rule log, rule automation and favorites are unchecked
the part remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is visible at the left of the workspace
the user opens the User Interface menu from the View ribbon tab
the user clears the Model Browser option
the model browser is hidden
the viewport extends into the space it occupied
the user reopens the User Interface menu
the Model Browser option is unchecked
the user selects the Model Browser option again
the model browser returns to the left of the workspace
the user reopens the User Interface menu
the Model Browser option is checked

scenarios.scenario: Float and redock the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked to the left edge of the workspace
the user drags the model browser by its header into the viewport
the model browser becomes a floating panel over the viewport
the viewport occupies the space previously used by the docked browser
the user drags the floating browser by its header to the left edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the left edge
the viewport occupies the remaining workspace

scenarios.scenario: Move the model browser between side docks

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked to the left edge of the workspace
the user drags its header to the right edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user drags its header to the left edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the left edge
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked to the left of the viewport
the user drags the boundary between the model browser and viewport to the right
the model browser becomes wider
the viewport becomes narrower
the document and model tree remain displayed
the user drags the boundary back to its original position
the model browser and viewport return to their previous widths
